note: Core gospel concepts shared by all study content, so the same idea becomes one node on the Discovery Map wherever it's studied. Content files may declare more concepts inline. Christlike attributes (charity, humility, patience, meekness, mercy, compassion, obedience, forgiveness, long-suffering) are attribute nodes defined in src/content/attributes/, not concepts. Descriptions are neutral summaries, not quotations.

concepts.label: Jesus Christ
concepts.description: The Son of God, the Savior and Redeemer of the world, whose life, teachings, Atonement, and Resurrection are at the center of the gospel.

concepts.label: Heavenly Father
concepts.description: God the Eternal Father, the Father of our spirits, whose plan makes salvation and exaltation possible.

concepts.label: The Holy Ghost
concepts.description: The third member of the Godhead, who testifies of the Father and the Son, teaches truth, and comforts.

concepts.label: The Godhead
concepts.description: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost: three distinct beings united in purpose.

concepts.label: Atonement of Jesus Christ
concepts.description: The Savior's suffering in Gethsemane and on the cross, His death, and His Resurrection, through which all people can be reconciled to God.

concepts.label: Resurrection
concepts.description: The reuniting of the spirit with a perfected, immortal body, made possible for all people by Jesus Christ.

concepts.label: Grace
concepts.description: Divine help and strength given through the mercy and love of Jesus Christ.

concepts.label: Succor
concepts.description: To run to help or relieve someone in need; used in scripture for the Savior's help to His people.

concepts.label: Infinite Atonement
concepts.description: The teaching that the Atonement of Jesus Christ reaches all people, all sins, and all suffering.

concepts.label: Repentance
concepts.description: A change of mind and heart that turns a person away from sin and toward God, made possible through Jesus Christ.

concepts.label: Forgiveness of sins
concepts.description: God's release of a repentant person from the guilt and penalty of sin, through Jesus Christ.

concepts.label: Sin
concepts.description: Willfully disobeying God's commandments or failing to act righteously despite knowing the truth.

concepts.label: Weakness
concepts.description: Mortal limitations and imperfections that are part of the human condition; distinct from sin.

concepts.label: The natural man
concepts.description: The fallen, mortal tendency of human beings that is overcome through the Atonement of Jesus Christ and yielding to the Holy Spirit.

concepts.label: Faith in Jesus Christ
concepts.description: Trust in and reliance on Jesus Christ that leads a person to act.

concepts.label: Hope
concepts.description: Confident expectation of promised blessings through Jesus Christ.

concepts.label: God's love
concepts.description: The love of Heavenly Father and Jesus Christ for every person.

concepts.label: Plan of salvation
concepts.description: Heavenly Father's plan for the happiness and eternal progress of His children, centered on Jesus Christ.

concepts.label: Agency
concepts.description: The ability and privilege God gives His children to choose and act for themselves.

concepts.label: Opposition
concepts.description: The teaching that there must be opposition in all things for agency and growth to be possible.

concepts.label: Adversity and trials
concepts.description: Hardships, afflictions, and suffering experienced in mortality.

concepts.label: Mortal life
concepts.description: Life on earth with a physical body: a time to learn, grow, and prepare to meet God.

concepts.label: Revelation
concepts.description: Communication from God to His children.

concepts.label: Personal revelation
concepts.description: Revelation that individuals receive through the Holy Ghost for their own lives.

concepts.label: Still small voice
concepts.description: A scriptural description of how the Spirit often speaks: quietly rather than forcefully.

concepts.label: Fruits of the Spirit
concepts.description: Qualities the Spirit produces, such as love, joy, and peace.

concepts.label: Prayer
concepts.description: Communication with Heavenly Father in the name of Jesus Christ.

concepts.label: The word of God
concepts.description: Scripture and the words of prophets, through which God teaches His children.

concepts.label: Testimony
concepts.description: A spiritual witness of truth given by the Holy Ghost.

concepts.label: Conversion
concepts.description: A deep change of heart and commitment to follow Jesus Christ.

concepts.label: Primary and secondary questions
concepts.description: Elder Lawrence E. Corbridge's distinction between the few most important questions of faith and the many questions that depend on them.

concepts.label: Ways of learning truth
concepts.description: Elder Corbridge's four methods of learning: scientific, analytical, academic, and divine. All begin with a question.

concepts.label: The Restoration
concepts.description: The return of the fulness of the gospel of Jesus Christ and His Church through the Prophet Joseph Smith.

concepts.label: Doctrine of Christ
concepts.description: Faith in Jesus Christ, repentance, baptism, receiving the Holy Ghost, and enduring to the end.

concepts.label: Covenants
concepts.description: Sacred promises between God and His children.

concepts.label: Ordinances
concepts.description: Sacred acts performed by priesthood authority, such as baptism.

concepts.label: Eternal families
concepts.description: The teaching that family relationships can continue after death through sealing ordinances and faithfulness.

concepts.label: Spirit world
concepts.description: Where spirits go after death to await the Resurrection, where the gospel is also taught.

concepts.label: Salvation for the dead
concepts.description: The opportunity for those who died without the gospel to receive it, with ordinances performed on their behalf.

concepts.label: Judgment
concepts.description: God's righteous and merciful judgment of each person, according to their works and the desires of their hearts.

concepts.label: Fear of God
concepts.description: In scripture, often reverence and awe toward God, rather than terror.

concepts.label: Reverence
concepts.description: Deep respect and love toward God.

concepts.label: Friendship with God
concepts.description: The relationship the Savior described when He called His disciples His friends.

concepts.label: Discipleship
concepts.description: Following Jesus Christ by learning of Him, keeping His commandments, and becoming like Him.
